text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! See? I knew it. You don't<n>need to be from
a famous family to<n>win.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We can all shake hands with anyone<n>we'd like!
Bonds are something that<n>can be fostered and
grown. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl runs well against<n>Mejiro Dober
and proves her<n>potential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That was a great race, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family is my pride and<n>joy. I think it's
wonderful, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see you, too, share deep bonds with<n>people who
are just as close as<n>family to you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that's another form of<n>family in and of
itself. Your family is<n>stupendous as well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My family?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Why are you saying that like you're<n>some kind of
outsider? You're part of<n>my family too, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? I am?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'd never be so petty as to<n>turn away
someone just because<n>they're part of another
Umamusume<n>family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's welcome! I don't care if<n>you're
already part of another family!<n>One day, everyone in
the world will be<n>part of mine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the Pearl family, Mejiro<n>Dober! I dub
thee family member<n>number two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The Pearl family, you say... And I'm<n>its second
addition?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haha. I'm a bit upset I wasn't the<n>first.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. Sorry, but that spot's long<n>been booked.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's reserved for the person who<n>believed in my
possibilities and<n>wanted to share them with the
world.<n>♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl looks at me and<n>winks. And with
that, the curtains fall<n>on both her junior year and
her fierce<n>battle with the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. That went just as planned. We<n>shouldn't
have any problems<n>growing the Pearl family going
forward.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Was it not? Oh well! Think of it<n>as a side quest
as we take on the<n>world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With Dober as member number two<n>and Bright as
member number three,<n>my family just keeps
getting bigger...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And now that I have a sizable family,<n>there's only
one thing to do next<n>year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Do you even have to ask? We need<n>to go see the
cherry blossoms<n>together! Let's go see them when
they're in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And by that, I mean we take on the<n>Oka Sho! That's
not a problem, is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho. It measures 1,600<n>meters and is the
first race of the<n>Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see no issues with the difficulty or<n>distance of the
race. In fact, it's close<n>to being the most ideal race
Seeking<n>the Pearl can run.
choice_data_list: It's no problem at all! All right! The Oka Sho it is!
It's no problem at all! All right! The Oka Sho it is!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! Let's keep showing<n>the world
more of my limitless<n>possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My classic year will be the runway<n>leading out to
the big, wide world, and<n>I'm planning to sprint down
it with all<n>my might!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!
